Anonymous Swapping Logic: Users list items and anonymously like others' listings; mutual likes form swap candidates without revealing identities until listing ends.
Timed Listings & Matchmaking: Each listing runs for a fixed duration (e.g., 3 or 7 days), after which a leaderboard of mutual matches is generated for swap selection.
Priority-Based Swap Decisions: The user who listed first gets the first choice to finalize a swap from their leaderboard, ensuring fair and structured match resolution.
Leaderboard-Based UI: Users see a curated leaderboard of matched listings; selected items are removed from all other leaderboards once a swap is confirmed.
Boosts & Unlocks for Monetization: Users can pay to boost their listing’s visibility or unlock additional swap candidates lower down the leaderboard.
